_doc: Offline voice pack: eight demo lines spoken through SpeechSynthesis when scripted scenarios run. Shown with a SIM badge. {name} is replaced with the crew member's display name.

lines.greet: Hello {name}. Sentinel is awake and listening.
lines.scan: Let me see you. Running a full scan now.
lines.scan_ok: Scan complete. Everything is within your usual range.
lines.tired: {name}, you are talking less and your pitch is flatter than your usual, and your heart rate is above your baseline. The fatigue reading around your eyes is raised.
lines.offer_calm: Would you like a short Orb Calm session? Breathe in with the orb for four, and out for six.
lines.calm_done: Your heart rate is settling back toward your usual. Well done.
lines.cabin: Caution. Cabin oxygen is below the safe line. I have flagged it to ground. Please acknowledge.
lines.hardware: This is the wearable we have designed for Sentinel. It is a design, not yet built.
